high_value_stack_checks.tailwind_config_js_verdict: DEAD CODE. tailwind.config.js exists at frontend/web_app/tailwind.config.js (235 lines) and is a valid v3-style CJS config, but it is NEVER LOADED under v4: there is no `@config` directive anywhere in any CSS file under src (grep count 0), globals.css uses `@import "tailwindcss"` (line 3), and postcss.config.mjs loads only `@tailwindcss/postcss` + `autoprefixer`. v4 ignores tailwind.config.js unless explicitly bridged with @config. PROVEN EMPIRICALLY against the production build: utilities defined ONLY in tailwind.config.js are absent from every emitted CSS file under .next/static and .next/dev: .text-2xs (0), .text-3xs (0), .text-4xs (0), .text-5xs (0), .text-display (0), .max-w-11xl (0), .p-4.5 (0). Control classes DO appear: .max-w-7xl (present), .text-sm (present), .grid-cols-8 (present), .md\:hidden (present), .sm\:flex (present), .lg\:grid-cols-8 (present). SOURCE IMPACT: text-3xs is used 128 times across 42 files, text-4xs 30 times / 11 files, text-5xs 15 times / 5 files, max-w-11xl 7 times / 7 files — all silently rendering with NO font-size / NO max-width.
high_value_stack_checks.react_query_detail: Law 171 (ARCHITECTURE_STACK.md:697) says @tanstack/react-query and SWR are FORBIDDEN. Source occurrences = 3 import sites: src/app/providers.tsx:3, src/components/QueryErrorBoundary.tsx:16, src/lib/api/queryStates.ts:14. `swr` occurrence count = 0. NOT DECLARED in package.json and NOT in pnpm-lock.yaml (grep count 0) — but present in package-lock.json (line 14, ^5.104.0), i.e. an npm-installed leftover. It is also NOT resolvable at runtime: node_modules/@tanstack contains only `query-core`; `require.resolve('@tanstack/react-query')` returns MODULE_NOT_FOUND. high_value_stack_checks.next_build_typecheck_failure: PARTIALLY REAL — REFRAMED AS P0. (a) The specific claim `Module not found: Can't resolve '@/stores/currencyStore'` at frontend/web_app/src/app/admin/analytics/page.tsx:12 is FALSE — that line reads `import { useCurrencyStore } from "@/lib/currencyStore";` (page.tsx:12) and src/lib/currencyStore.ts exists. There is NO `@/stores/currencyStore` import anywhere in src; `@/stores/*` resolves exactly once (toastStore, which exists at src/stores/toastStore.ts). (b) The broader claim that typecheck is broken IS REAL: `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits 2 with 119 errors across 29 files (TS2322 x60, TS2339 x11, TS2305 x11, TS2353 x8, TS7006 x6, TS2307 x4, TS2604 x3, TS2786 x3, TS2503 x2, TS2559 x2, TS7031 x2, TS2614 x2, TS2304/TS2551/TS2345/TS7016/TS2459 x1 each). So Law 186 ('next build passes with no errors') is only satisfied because type errors are suppressed at the config level. That suppression is itself the P0 defect: it hides 119 real type errors from CI.

This meets the compiler's cross-cutting test on both counts: >= 5 files, and a config file governing the whole codebase with no single meaningful File:Line. THE FIX IS A DECISION, NOT A FINDING: either bridge v3 config into v4 with `@config "../tailwind.config.js"` in globals.css, or migrate the tokens into a v4 `@theme` block.
